title: How One Honest Text to a Brother Breaks What Isolation Feeds
caption:
Isolation doesn't announce itself as danger. It just feels like peace, right up until it isn't.

The sin that grows fastest is the one nobody else can see. Pick one man. Tell him the actual truth, not the safe version. Let him ask you again next week.

One honest text does what isolation can't survive.

#faith #brotherhood #christianmen #accountability #manofgod
